title: SDK environment endpoint is omitted from annotation fingerprint
reproduction: Run test_observation_sdk_environment_endpoint_is_missing_from_fingerprint: stage under OPENAI_BASE_URL=A; replay under B; force a new job under B. A/B final HTTP URLs differ but fingerprints are equal and the old candidate is replayed.
expected: The identity covers the final endpoint consumed by the actual SDK.
actual: Official OpenAI default route is empty in the fingerprint; SDK independently applies OPENAI_BASE_URL.
impact: A candidate from another endpoint can be reused after an endpoint change.
evidence_type: reproduced with real OpenAI SDK and final HTTP MockTransport capture
recommendation: Resolve final SDK endpoint before request identity and client acquisition; use that single result for identity, pool and SDK constructor.

title: Staging failure does not wake a paused peer and delays product failure publication
expected: Failure stops requests not yet dispatched, wakes internal pause waits, preserves the storage error, and releases worker ownership before reporting failed.
actual: Executor shutdown waits for a peer in the real pause loop; product retains its worker lock without publishing error. Manual Continue permits another model request before failed is published.
impact: Failure cleanup requires manual intervention; a post-failure request can create additional paid work. Manual cancel/unpause can recover, so this is not an irreversible deadlock.
evidence_type: reproduced actual background-worker API, real pause checkpoints, runtime/lock observations, and final HTTP MockTransport capture
recommendation: Propagate an annotation fail-stop reason to pause/provider-gate/predispatch checks and wake waiters; preserve original failure classification and release worker/heartbeat ownership.
